capabilities: Pull highlights from Acorny's read-only export feed
Write one Markdown note per source with frontmatter and a highlights list
Append new highlights idempotently while preserving manual edits
Match notes by acorny-source-id so renames do not create duplicates
Trigger sync manually, on startup, or on an interval
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not sync your vault across devices; it is a one-way import of Acorny highlights into notes.
extras: Beta installs go through the BRAT plugin; the read-only export token is stored in the plugin data file inside the vault and the README warns not to publicly sync or share that folder.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to import and keep updated the highlights you make in the Acorny reading service.

relations.evidence: Pulls highlights from Acorny's read-only export feed (/api/v1/exports/highlights/feed).

summary: Pulls highlights from the Acorny reading service into your vault as one Markdown note per source, appending new highlights idempotently.
